why_the_score_is_what_it_is: Country diversification reads 1,061.5 HHI, which scores 88 out of 100.
Valuation reads 21.91 % weighted FCF margin, which scores 82 out of 100.
Holdings concentration reads 12 % in top ten, which scores 88 out of 100.
what_could_go_wrong: Currency risk structure scores only 45 out of 100.
Beta to the S&P 500 reads 0.77 x, scoring 81.
why_laura_should_care: This belongs to growth capital, not to the money dedicated to the ten fixed payments.
Her mandatory payments are protected by dated instruments elsewhere in the portfolio.
Modelled funding probability is 99.9% against the team's 95% floor, so this position does not weaken funding certainty.

review_triggers: Modelled operating funding probability falls below 95%.
Laura's stated objectives or the residency timeline change.
The index methodology or the fund's selection rules change.
Portfolio overlap with another holding increases materially.
A sector concentration limit is breached after a rebalance.

registry_drift.note: Charged to data confidence, not to the score itself. The figures above still come from the transcribed registry; what drift changes is how much the engine claims to trust them. Yahoo is tier 2, so a disagreement is a prompt to re-read the issuer factsheet, not a correction in its own right.
